input_reconstruction_checks.scope: Input and rounded-readiness consistency only. These are not simulated damage or winner errors.

attribution_axes.scope: Ownership and mechanism are separate axes; adding summons or shields on top of an inclusive hero row double counts.

counter_reconciliation.rounding_scope: Conservative one full display unit per row, not a claimed rounding algorithm. Comparison includes pet outgoing rows but only visible hero incoming rows; missing actor coverage and attribution must be checked before treating residual as model error. Shields enter both counters when both endpoints resolve, so shields alone do not prove the cause.

held_out_simulation.scope: Same definition, current model hash, held-out timestamped predictions only. WAPE is an error ratio, not winner or global ranking accuracy.

matched_global_scoring.scope: Agreement for the declared outcome metric and reviewed matched context. Does not imply universal balanced-score accuracy.

next_measurable_tests: Freeze a complete prediction with model and input hashes before an independent outcome.
Use owner-inclusive report damage as a distinct target from HP removed; never compare the two definitions.
For squad-score validation compare fresh identical enemy states, exact builds/context and troop count, with no uncontrolled rally participants; record the declared outcome metric.

health_balance_hypothesis.hypothesis: Displayed outgoing damage is gross pressure while the incoming column may describe net HP depletion. Test outgoing = taken + effective recovery + shield/overkill/coverage terms; reported shown healing is only a proxy for effective recovery.
health_balance_hypothesis.status: Consistent within display precision in the friendly-outgoing direction. Reverse direction retains a positive residual; this is evidence for a bookkeeping hypothesis, not proof of the server counter definitions.
limits: Shown healing may differ from effective recovery and may have recipient coverage not visible in the report.
The remaining reverse-direction residual could include overkill, shields, omitted recovery or actor coverage; it is not assigned to any one cause.
Neither per-hero damage predictions nor global scoring weights are calibrated by this accounting identity.
Conservative display budgets use one full shown unit per value, not an assumed exact rounding implementation.

retrospective_reconstruction.scope: Fitted retrospective results are measurable without a repeat fight. They are distinct from independent future-battle accuracy.
